name: Gobind Singh Deo
_note: M2 full-cabinet completion: Minister of Digital since the 12 Dec 2023 reshuffle. Layer B (Editorial Panel) is a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. metrics.justification: No personal corruption or criminal matter of record. As a lawyer he acted as defence counsel in others' trials (withdrawing on his ministerial reappointment), and a 2009 parliamentary suspension over remarks was later resolved in his favour by the Federal Court; neither is a criminal or anti-corruption matter against him.

metrics.justification: On data-security incidents in his remit (a claimed 17-million-record identity leak in Dec 2024; the Aug 2024 Prasarana ransomware attack) the regulators under his ministry opened probes and he disclosed a sharp rise in breach cases to the Dewan Rakyat (17 Oct 2024), but the visible front-line response on the identity-leak claim came from other agencies and outcomes were denials or open investigations rather than measurable remedies (anchor 2).

citation.title: Data protection commissioner probes Prasarana ransomware attack

metrics.justification: Tabled and delivered two operative laws: the Cyber Security Act 2024 (in force with regulations 26 Aug 2024) and the Personal Data Protection (Amendment) Act 2024 (gazetted 17 Oct 2024, breach-notification duties from 1 Jun 2025); the digital-ID rollout missed its "early 2025" target. Major reforms gazetted alongside one missed timeline (anchor 3).

citation.title: Malaysia Cyber Security Act 2024 and Subsidiary Regulations — In Force on 26 August 2024

metrics.justification: The Cyber Security Act 2024 gave the National Cyber Security Agency (NACSA) statutory footing as regulator of national critical information infrastructure, and NACSA took on an ASEAN regional CERT leadership role. Documented strengthening of an institution under legislation he carried (anchor 3).

citation.title: Malaysia To Enhance ASEAN Cybersecurity With Regional CERT Leadership — Gobind

metrics.justification: On the reversal of the single-wholesale-network 5G policy to a dual-network model (effective 1 Jan 2025), he explained the rationale on the record and in Parliament (avoiding a single point of failure, protecting public funds sunk into the network operator). Reversal of execution explained openly, though the original pivot was a Cabinet decision predating his tenure (anchor 3).
